name: Rowbly Updater
description:
We want to tell users when their is a new version of rowbly available.

- When starting up rowbly, run an async check to see if there is a new version available
- Check npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/rowbly
- If a new version is available, inform the user that they can update by running `npm i -g rowbly`

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor: ROW68 plan ACCEPTED with refinements. Bare rowbly starts the TUI, so TUI-only startup check satisfies this Story; commands/JSON/no-prompt/agents make no request and gain no output. Latest stable npm manifest only, no updater/installation feature, failures silent and startup nonblocking. Confirm aborting on exit also clears all timeout/request handles so no rejection or delayed exit; handle stale/unmounted promise resolution safely. ROWBLY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 and demo skip accepted. No need cache/preferences machinery. Preserve readable update text and npm i -g rowbly at normal80-column width; do not accept an unreadable notice merely as a known risk. Use width-aware existing footer conventions, shorten/replace current-version area or a small existing-layout message as needed while retaining usable key hints; show80 and narrow screenshots. Avoid unsolicited new TUI context abstraction if simple existing wiring suffices. ADR0047 is RESERVED for ROW53 guide exception if user approves and0048 reservedROW50heartbeat; use0049 provisionally for ROW68 firstnetworkcall decision, recheck allmain/openPR reservations. Keep ADR concise/current behavior, no reversal of existing decisions. Manual controlled network success/failure/hang/abort scenarios plus exactTUI startup/quit and optout, commandJSON unchanged; fourchecks required. Extend a kept test only if AGENTS required contract/race rules genuinely apply, no mirror tests. All screenshot evidence withagenticTUI, temporary versionoverride outside taskbranch allowed, rawPNGs200. Fetch/merge currentmain before implementation/finalchecks, keep plan scope, noBoardwrites. Proceed.
